title: Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain (Trampoline St, approx.): man, 43, shot dead, 1 Oct
summary: Police say a 43-year-old man sitting in a white Hyundai truck was pulled out by two men and shot dead in front of a premises on Trampoline Street, Beacon Valley, at 11:10 on Thursday 1 October; the suspects took his fire...
story: Police say a 43-year-old man sitting in a white Hyundai truck was pulled out by two men and shot dead in front of a premises on Trampoline Street, Beacon Valley, at 11:10 on Thursday 1 October; the suspects took his firearm and fled towards Hengelaar Road (Plainsman, quoting police spokesperson FC van Wyk).
location_note: Trampoline Street, Beacon Valley (exact spot not given). The pin is the middle of the street, which OpenStreetMap places on the Eastridge side of Beacon Valley.

provenance.note: One report, based on the police statement.

sources.name: F.C. van Wyk, provincial police
sources.quote: The victim attempted to reach for his firearm when one of the suspects produced a firearm and shot him, killing him.
